notes: CKAN dataset id on datos.cdmx.gob.mx (Fiscalía General de Justicia): investigation files (carpetas de investigación), one cumulative CSV (zip) republished every month, 2016 onwards, ~2 million rows. The module takes the most recent CSV/zip resource.
Optional: a direct URL of the cumulative CSV or zip when the API answer cannot be read.
CKAN dataset id of the colonias layer (catalogue of colonias with alcaldía codes); the module takes a GeoJSON / shapefile zip resource. Change the id if the portal renames it (run cdmx_inspect()).
Optional: a direct URL of the colonias GeoJSON or shapefile zip.
